# The Hijacker Who Vanished

On November 24, 1971, a quiet man in a dark suit bought a plane ticket under the name Dan Cooper. A few hours later, he jumped out of that plane with $200,000, and nobody ever saw him again.

## The Note

Shortly after takeoff, Cooper handed a flight attendant a note. It said he had a bomb in his briefcase. He opened the case and showed her red sticks and wires. He calmly asked for $200,000 in cash and four parachutes.

## The Search

Hundreds of soldiers and FBI agents searched the woods for weeks. They found nothing. In 1980, a boy found $5,800 in rotting bills on a riverbank. The police never found the rest of the ransom.

## Conclusion

The FBI looked at more than 800 suspects. It is still the only unsolved hijacking in American history.
